sheetInventory.note: 43 rows carry a threshold_mean and/or threshold_median; 7 rows carry an off_flavors marker; 6 rows carry both. Every other row of the 261 is a compound name without a numeric threshold and is NOT invented into a column.

nameMatching.joinKey: field_name_R (the R-style name) -> 1.csv column name, exact match
nameMatching.explanation: The sheet names compounds the way R munges them ("X2.3.butanedione", "acetic_acid.g.L."), while 1.csv uses the same munging, so field_name_R is an exact join key for 43/43 threshold rows. The human-readable field_name_python matches only 18/43 exactly ("2,3-butanedione", "X4VG", "(E)-2-nonenal") because it keeps commas/spaces/parentheses; a normalised comparison lifts it to 39/43. chemical_name is a display name ("Diacetyl", "4-vinylguaiacol") and matches only 24/43 by normalisation. Two mojibake characters (\u00ce\u00b1/\u00ce\u00b2 for alpha/beta) were repaired before matching; no column was matched by hand.

defectThresholdSetUsed.decidedAt: data layer (data-engineer), before any Q3 modelling
defectThresholdSetUsed.rule: A compound is a DEFECT constraint only if (a) the problem statement names it among the defect compounds OR 8.xlsx carries an off_flavors marker for it, AND (b) 8.xlsx carries a real numeric threshold for it. Thresholds that merely describe a typical/detection level (bitterness 5 IBU, ethanol 1.76 %v/v, protein 1.02 g/L ...) are REFERENCE levels: they stay in the dataset as thr__ columns but must never be used to declare a defect.

notEvaluable.label: trans-2-nonenal
notEvaluable.reason: the compound exists in the sheet AND in 1.csv (X.E..2.nonenal), but the sheet has no numeric threshold for it: the defect constraint is NOT evaluable from this attachment and no value is invented.

exceedanceInterpretation: These fractions are a UNIT/TRANSFORM sanity check, not a defect classification. They are computed as raw_concentration > threshold_mean, with raw = 10**value for log10/zero-floor columns and raw = value for raw columns. They behave as expected for the named defect compounds (DMS 0.672, diacetyl 0.448, 4VG 0.064, DES 0.184, H2S 0.920 above threshold; acetaldehyde 0.000 and CS2 0.000 because those thresholds are far above the measured range), which is why the assumed unit alignment is credible. But the sheet mixes true off-flavour thresholds with ordinary sensory/typical levels (bitterness 5 IBU, ethanol 1.76 %v/v, protein 1.02 g/L are above-threshold for 86-99%% of samples and are NOT defects). Q3 must therefore restrict "defect" to the compounds the problem names plus the 7 off_flavors-flagged rows, and report the rest as reference levels.

styleHoldout.note: A style-level holdout is the only honest way to test cross-style transfer: the problem asks for generation under a held-out style, so 49 rows of Tripel/Kriek/Lambic are labelled heldout_style and the remaining 201 rows train_style. The Q3 random split registered on this table is a separate, row-level split for the unconditional baseline.

forbiddenInputs.gbmImportanceMDI: NOT written: it is a model output fitted on these same 250 samples (target leakage).
forbiddenInputs.beerPrices: NOT written and not a core input: 7 price columns with heavy NA; style/ABV metadata cannot explain compound spectra.
forbiddenInputs.calibratedChemicalDataset: used only as the scale reference for the 70 alignable columns (data_quality.json -> scaleAudit / calibratedCrossCheck); it is not a column of q3_table.csv.

notes: Thresholds are constants from the attachment, not fitted quantities; they are the same in every row by construction, so any per-row variation would be a bug.

The threshold unit is the sheet unit (mg/L or ug/L per compound, per the sheet). 1.csv carries no unit, so turning chem__ values into an OAV needs the transform from data_quality.json AND the unit assumption recorded in exceedanceCheck.assumedConcentrationUnit.

The five defect compounds named by the problem are resolved one by one in notParsed.defectCompoundsNamedByProblem; two of them (trans-2-nonenal, Stale hops) genuinely have no numeric threshold in the attachment and must be reported as such rather than fixed by assumption.
